unique_commits.message:
feat(android): wire hardware back button policy and harden atomic export renames

Android hardware back was unwired (ANDROID_BACK_BUTTON_UNWIRED): the
platform default finished the activity from any screen. The renderer now
installs a single Capacitor App backButton listener that owns the full
policy: close the AI assistant, close the mobile drawer, leave
fullscreen, honor screen-level interceptors (home overlay, player resume
prompt, playback tools, video-studio save guard), navigate the recorded
view history, and require a double press at the root view to exit.

- src/platform/androidBackButton.ts: testable controller + runtime install
- wired into main.tsx, MobileHomeDashboard, UltimateMobilePlayerSession,
  MobileVideoStudioView (save-before-leave), runtime type declarations
- CI installs @capacitor/app 8.1.2 and asserts the synced plugin surface
- android-emulator-smoke.sh now proves intercept-then-exit on the emulator
- writeFileAtomic retries transient Win32 rename contention (EPERM/EACCES/
  EBUSY) so racing exports cannot fail on antivirus/indexer handles
